title: Pardesaan Day Vich Ja Kay Koyi Dukh Na Uthaye
body:
Houn Phuppiyaan Tay Pehnaan, Majboor Tay Qaidi
Houn Phuppiyan Tay Pehnaan, Koyi Naal Ehna Day
Bazaarna Jaye, Sajjad Day Vanghu.
<<DIVIDER>>
Zindan Di Talkhi Nay Sakina Nu Muka Chadeya
Koyi Jag Tay Bhira Nayee Mazloom Eh Vainda
Jo Bhen Nu Loko Haye, Kafan Na Paaye Sajaad Day Vanghu.
<<DIVIDER>>
Phuppiyaan Diyaan Chadaraan Da Lag Zakham Gay Dil Tay
Ghairat Layee Kisay Nay, Aj Teek Ay Loko
Ghairat Layee Kisay Nay, Akhiyaan Chon Laahu Day
Athroon Nayee Vaghaye, Sajaad Day Vanghu.
<<DIVIDER>>
Meray Naal Eh Mastooran Zahra Diyaan Jaiyaan Nay
Menu Baghi Na Aakho, May Sibtay Nabhi Haan
Menu Baghi Na Aakho, Mehnoshaan Ch’ Koyi
Khutbay Na Sunaye, Sajaad Day Vanghu.
<<DIVIDER>>
Tareekh Enu Taayon Dardan Da Khuda Aakhay
Haath Kariyaan Vi Hovaan, Gaal Touq Vi Bhaari
Haath Kariyaan Vi Hovaan, Ja Bhain Da Lasha
Zindaan Ichon Chaye, Sajaad Day Vanghu.
<<DIVIDER>>
Akhtar Eh Dua Mangda Sadqa Dukhi Zainab Dah
Koyi Matami Shala, Majboor Na Hovay
Koyi Matami Shala, Bay Jurm Kadi Vi
Na Qaidaan Nibhaye, Sajaad Day Vanghu.
